units: Gen. R. s. 78; s. 92 שמענו ח׳ בי״א וכ׳ we find grace applied to the eleven tribes (before Benjamin was born; Gen. XXXIII, 5).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:9">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> (play on Ḥannin) <he>בעת חֲנִינָתוֹ אבד חַנִּינוֹ</he> (v. <cite ref="H01288"><he>חֲנִיכָה</he></cite>) at the moment of his receiving caresses died he who was to caress him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:14">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>דבי ר׳ חנינה אמרי ח׳ שמו</he> the disciples of R. Ḥ. said, the Messiah’s name is Ḥ.
